verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an inference platform, but every piece of evidence describes Fireworks-operated infrastructure: serverless calls to api.fireworks.ai, on-demand dedicated GPUs, and a Fireworks-run global fleet. Nothing documents a self-hosted, on-prem, or bring-your-own-cloud deployment of the core product. The open-source benchmarking tool is an ancillary utility, not the core product.
